description: This file contains unit tests for the HibernateConceptDAO class within the OpenMRS project, specifically testing concept and drug retrieval methods, concept attribute counting, and concept mapping functionalities in the context of the Hibernate ORM implementation.

classes.name: HibernateConceptDAOTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for HibernateConceptDAO implementation within the OpenMRS platform, testing various concept and drug retrieval functionalities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data before each test, loading dataset and updating search index.

methods.name: getDrugs_shouldReturnDrugIf_eitherDrugNameOrConceptNameMatchesThePhaseNotBoth
methods.description: Tests retrieval of drugs based on matching either drug or concept name.

methods.name: getDrugs_shouldReturnDistinctDrugs
methods.description: Ensures that the list of drugs returned is distinct even when multiple criteria match.

methods.name: getDrugs_shouldReturnDrugIfPhraseMatchDrugNameNoNeedToMatchBothConceptNameAndDrugName
methods.description: Tests search with phrase matching drug name without matching concept name.

methods.name: getDrugs_shouldReturnDrugIfPhaseMatchConceptNameNoNeedToMatchBothConceptNameAndDrugName
methods.description: Tests search with phrase matching concept name without matching drug name.

methods.name: getDrugs_shouldReturnDrugWhenPhraseMatchDrugNameEvenSerchDrugConceeptNameIsfalse
methods.description: Verifies that drug is returned when phrase matches drug name, ignoring concept name matching.

methods.name: getDrugs_shouldNotReturnRetired
methods.description: Ensures retired drugs are excluded from search results.

methods.name: getDrugs_shouldReturnNonRetired
methods.description: Checks that non-retired drugs are included in search results.

methods.name: getDrugs_shouldReturnDrugEvenIf_DrugNameHasSpecialCharacters
methods.description: Tests search for drug names with special characters.

methods.name: shouldGetConceptAttributeCountForAttributeType
methods.description: Tests counting of concept attributes for a specific attribute type.

methods.name: isConceptNameDuplicate_shouldNotFailIfConceptDoesNotHaveADefaultNameForLocale
methods.description: Checks for proper handling of concept name duplication detection when locale-specific names are added.

methods.name: getConceptIdsByMapping_shouldReturnDistinctConceptIds
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of concept IDs associated with a given mapping, ensuring no duplicates are returned.

methods.name: getConceptDatatypes_shouldReturnDatatypesWithNameStartingWithGivenString
methods.description: Tests fetching concept data types filtered by name prefix.

methods.name: getConceptDatatypes_shouldReturnEmptyListForNonExistentName
methods.description: Ensures empty list is returned when no data types match the given prefix.

methods.name: getConceptReferenceRangesByConceptId_shouldReturnEmptyListForIfNoConceptReferenceRangeIsLinkedToConcept
methods.description: Confirms that an empty list is returned if a concept has no reference ranges linked.
